mapper.select: SELECT c.connection_id, c.from_station_id, c.to_station_id, c.travel_time, s1.station_name as from_station_name, s2.station_name as to_station_name FROM connections c INNER JOIN stations s1 ON c.from_station_id = s1.station_id INNER JOIN stations s2 ON c.to_station_id = s2.station_id ORDER BY c.from_station_id, c.to_station_id

SELECT c.connection_id, c.from_station_id, c.to_station_id, c.travel_time, s1.station_name as from_station_name, s2.station_name as to_station_name FROM connections c INNER JOIN stations s1 ON c.from_station_id = s1.station_id INNER JOIN stations s2 ON c.to_station_id = s2.station_id WHERE c.from_station_id = #{fromStationId}
